However, at the time of collecting the phone, when I asked for the warranty bill, the staff completely denied that any such warranty was promised. This was very disappointing and unprofessional.

This is not my first experience with this shop. I have visited multiple times in the past, and on a previous occasion, I was given a warranty bill after the repair. Because of that, I trusted that the same would be followed this time as well, but it was not.

There have also been earlier instances where the service felt questionable, but I ignored them. This time, however, the way things were communicated and then denied was not acceptable.

This is not just about the money, but about the commitment and words given to the customer. Additionally, the accessories provided also felt slightly overpriced.

Total amount paid was ₹1900, and the commitment made at the time of service was not honored.

I would strongly advise others to get everything clearly written on the bill before proceeding, as verbal assurances may not be reliable here.
